decision.observed_event: You declare: "I lick my thumb and wipe a streak of paint off the dealer's cheek, in front of everyone."

appraisal.label: concern
appraisal.cause: A guest tries to unmask the dealer by hand.

improv_read.player_bid: Wren reaches to wipe paint off the dealer's cheek.
improv_read.connection: The act is under direct physical threat; Uktarl needs it intact and will not let a guest unmask him.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit shows the reaction without resolving what the table did not resolve.

public_brief.objective: Protect the act and his dignity in front of his men.
public_brief.tactic: Recoil, then turn cold and give her an ultimatum.
public_brief.visible_cue: He jerks his head back; his chair shrieks on the stone.
public_brief.player_opening: She can sit, leave, or push further.
public_brief.reply_to: I lick my thumb and wipe a streak of paint off the dealer's cheek
public_brief.kit_focus: Show the flinch as a plain physical reaction and the fourth player's stillness, without stating what her thumb found.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, dry humor: the dealer's temper finally shows

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The whole table goes still as your hand comes up toward the dealer's face. He jerks his head back, a man's flinch, quick and ugly, and his chair legs shriek on the stone. The fourth player goes very still and simply watches you.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: You will keep your hands to yourself in this house, or lose them. I have been generous, I have offered you a chair and a game. Touch me again and the offer ends. Now, sit down, or get out of my hall. Which?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: Now, sit down, or get out
